question:

German: Das generelle Vorgehen des Justizministeriums in Fällen der Wirtschaftskriminalität wurde von Befürwortern intensiv unter die Lupe genommen. Kenneth Polite Jr., ehemaliger stellvertretender Justizminister in der Kriminalabteilung, überarbeitete die Durchsetzungsrichtlinien der Abteilung für Unternehmen, um Strafverfolgungen einzuschränken.
English:

Observers praised some of the steps the department has taken under Attorney General Merrick Garland, such as the establishment of a database for economic crime. However, Biden’s Department of Justice has also relied heavily on the use of whistleblower provisions, which allow companies to delay or avoid prosecution, and has encouraged companies to report individual employees in order to avoid broader charges. Kenneth Polite Jr., former Deputy Attorney General in the Criminal Division, revised the department’s enforcement guidelines for companies to limit prosecutions.
ground_truth: The Department of Justice's overall approach to corporate crimes has come under intense scrutiny from advocates. While watchdogs have lauded some steps the department has taken during Merrick Garland's tenure as attorney general - like finally establishing a database on corporate crime - Biden's DOJ has also leaned heavily on leniency agreements that allow companies to defer or avoid prosecution, and encouraged companies to scapegoat individual employees so as to avoid a broader charge. Kenneth Polite Jr., former assistant attorney general for DOJ's Criminal Division, revised the division's corporate enforcement policy so as to limit prosecutions.

question:

Bei allen Immobilientypen (d. h. von einem bis zu vier Zimmern) sind die Mieten seit der Einführung des Lebenshaltungskostengesetzes im Oktober 2022 im zweistelligen Prozentbereich gestiegen und haben damit die durchschnittlichen jährlichen Mietsteigerungen der vorangegangenen zwölf Jahre um mindestens das Dreifache übertroffen.
English:
generated_answer: Almost 18 months ago, a cost of living bill was passed, the so-called “Cost of Living (Tenant Protection) (Scotland) Act 2022”. It was intended to cap rents for a limited period to counter the pressures of the cost of living crisis. However, the latest statistics from the Scottish government show that average rents for flats of all sizes have increased over the past year alone. The increase ranges from 11.7% for one-bedroom flats to 14.3% for two-bedroom flats. For all property types (i.e. from one to four bedrooms), rents have increased by double-digit percentages since the cost of living bill was introduced in October 2022, at least tripling the average annual rent increases of the previous twelve years.
ground_truth: Thus, we had the introduction of the Cost of Living (Tenant protection) (Scotland) Act 2022 nearly 18 months ago which sought to cap rents for a limited period to ease the pressures of the cost-of-living crisis. What we find now from the latest Scottish Government statistics is that, in the last year alone, average rents have increased in all sized properties, ranging from the lowest rise of 11.7 per cent for one-bedroom to the highest figure of 14.3 per cent for two-bedroom homes. Every type of property (from one to four bedroom to a room in a property) has had a double digit increase in rents since the Cost of Living legislation was introduced in October 2022, exceeding the annual average increases in rents over the previous 12 years by a factor of at least three.
